# Toolset `employer_vacancies`

Employer vacancy CRUD, drafts, publication, stats.

**23 tools.** Mutations require an explicit `confirm=true` argument; `Auth` marks tools that need an hh.ru token.

| Tool | Operation | Auth | Confirm | Description |
| --- | --- | :---: | :---: | --- |
| `employer_archive_vacancy` | `PUT /employers/{employer_id}/vacancies/archived/{vacancy_id}` | yes | yes | Move a published vacancy to the archive. Mutation: requires confirm=True. |
| `employer_create_vacancy` | `POST /vacancies` | yes | yes | Publish a new vacancy on behalf of the employer. The vacancy object goes into the `body` parameter. Mutation: requires confirm=True. |
| `employer_create_vacancy_draft` | `POST /vacancies/drafts` | yes | yes | Create a vacancy draft (published later with employer_publish_vacancy_draft). Mutation: requires confirm=True. |
| `employer_delete_auto_publication` | `DELETE /vacancies/auto_publication` | yes | yes | Cancel the scheduled automatic publication of a draft. Mutation: requires confirm=True. |
| `employer_delete_vacancy_draft` | `DELETE /vacancies/drafts/{draft_id}` | yes | yes | Delete a vacancy draft. Mutation: requires confirm=True. |
| `employer_get_preferred_negotiations_order` | `GET /vacancies/{id}/preferred_negotiations_order` | yes | – | Get the preferred sorting order of responses (negotiations) for the vacancy. |
| `employer_get_prolongate_info` | `GET /vacancies/{vacancy_id}/prolongate` | yes | – | Get information about prolonging a vacancy: possible terms and their cost before actually prolonging. |
| `employer_get_vacancy_draft` | `GET /vacancies/drafts/{draft_id}` | yes | – | Get one vacancy draft by its id. |
| `employer_get_vacancy_stats` | `GET /vacancies/{vacancy_id}/stats` | yes | – | Get statistics of a published vacancy: views, responses and other counters. |
| `employer_get_vacancy_upgrades` | `GET /vacancies/{vacancy_id}/upgrades` | yes | – | List paid upgrades (promotion options) available for the vacancy. |
| `employer_get_vacancy_visitors` | `GET /vacancies/{vacancy_id}/visitors` | yes | – | Get candidates who viewed the vacancy, with pagination. |
| `employer_hide_vacancy` | `PUT /employers/{employer_id}/vacancies/hidden/{vacancy_id}` | yes | yes | Hide (soft-delete) a vacancy: it leaves the search but can be restored. Mutation: requires confirm=True. |
| `employer_list_active_vacancies` | `GET /employers/{employer_id}/vacancies/active` | yes | – | List active (published) vacancies of the employer with filters by manager, region, text and pagination. |
| `employer_list_archived_vacancies` | `GET /employers/{employer_id}/vacancies/archived` | yes | – | List archived vacancies of the employer with manager filter, ordering and pagination. |
| `employer_list_draft_duplicates` | `GET /vacancies/drafts/{draft_id}/duplicates` | yes | – | Check the draft for duplicates among active vacancies of the employer before publishing. |
| `employer_list_hidden_vacancies` | `GET /employers/{employer_id}/vacancies/hidden` | yes | – | List hidden (deleted) vacancies of the employer; they can be restored with employer_unhide_vacancy. |
| `employer_list_vacancy_drafts` | `GET /vacancies/drafts` | yes | – | List vacancy drafts of the current employer with pagination. |
| `employer_prolongate_vacancy` | `POST /vacancies/{vacancy_id}/prolongate` | yes | yes | Prolong a published vacancy by publication_period days. Mutation: requires confirm=True. |
| `employer_publish_vacancy_draft` | `POST /vacancies/drafts/{draft_id}/publish` | yes | yes | Publish the vacancy stored in the draft. Mutation: requires confirm=True. |
| `employer_set_preferred_negotiations_order` | `PUT /vacancies/{id}/preferred_negotiations_order` | yes | yes | Set the preferred sorting order of responses for the vacancy: body like {"order": "last_change_time"} (sent form-encoded). Mutation: requires confirm=True. |
| `employer_unhide_vacancy` | `DELETE /employers/{employer_id}/vacancies/hidden/{vacancy_id}` | yes | yes | Restore a previously hidden vacancy from the deleted list. Mutation: requires confirm=True. |
| `employer_update_vacancy` | `PUT /vacancies/{vacancy_id}` | yes | yes | Edit a published vacancy: the full edited vacancy object goes into `body`. Mutation: requires confirm=True. |
| `employer_update_vacancy_draft` | `PUT /vacancies/drafts/{draft_id}` | yes | yes | Edit a vacancy draft: the edited draft fields go into `body`. Mutation: requires confirm=True. |
